data.action: 深夜伏在书桌前，单薄睡衣滑落肩头
data.camera: side view, medium shot, horizontal framing
data.description: 【洛琪希 · 书桌夜读】深夜书房昏黄的油灯下，洛琪希伏在堆满羊皮纸的书桌前，睡眼惺忪中单薄的睡衣滑落肩头。她揉了揉泛酸的眼睛，声音软糯迷糊——「唔……这道水系复合术式终于推导完成了……好困，抱我回床上去睡嘛……」
data.promptProse: Roxy rests one hand on the finished water-magic notes and rubs a tired eye with the other. The oil lamp lights the parchment and the nightgown slipped at one shoulder.
data.title: 洛琪希 · 书桌夜读
data.animaCaption: One hand rests on the finished notes while the other rubs a tired eye.
